<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="x_snc_airop_check_definition"><x_snc_airop_check_definition action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><ai_justification><![CDATA[Matter volume reflects active legal workload that benefits from Now Assist summarization and AI-assisted status tracking. Adequate matter volume enables AI to identify patterns, flag at-risk matters, and accelerate resolution.]]></ai_justification><check_name>Legal Matter Volume</check_name><check_script><![CDATA[(function() {
    try {
        if (!gs.tableExists("sn_lg_matter_matter")) {
            return { status: "value_blocker", actualValue: "Required table sn_lg_matter_matter not found", finding: "Legal Matter table is not available. Verify the Legal Service Delivery plugin is active." };
        }
        var ga = new GlideAggregate("sn_lg_matter_matter");
        ga.addAggregate("COUNT");
        ga.query();
        var c = ga.next() ? parseInt(ga.getAggregate("COUNT")) : 0;
        if (c >= 50) {
            return { status: "ready", actualValue: c + " legal matters", finding: c + " legal matters found. Now Assist LSD has sufficient matter data for AI-assisted legal triage and summarization." };
        } else if (c > 0) {
            return { status: "needs_attention", actualValue: c + " legal matters", finding: c + " legal matter(s) found (target: 50+). Limited matter volume reduces Now Assist LSD AI summarization accuracy." };
        } else {
            return { status: "value_blocker", actualValue: "0 legal matters", finding: "No legal matters found. Now Assist LSD requires matter data for AI-assisted legal triage and summarization." };
        }
    } catch(e) {
        return { status: "verification_needed", actualValue: "Check failed", finding: "Script execution error: " + e.message };
    }
})]]></check_script><is_active>true</is_active><is_clone_sensitive>false</is_clone_sensitive><is_manual>false</is_manual><module>LSD</module><number>CHK0003097</number><order/><remediation_guidance>Ensure legal matters are being managed through the LSD module.</remediation_guidance><sys_class_name>x_snc_airop_check_definition</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-06-18 18:14:18</sys_created_on><sys_id>8c54c5b5cf2d0fd48935fb251d851c74</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Legal Matter Volume</sys_name><sys_package display_value="ServiceNow AI Readiness Optimization Platform" source="x_snc_airop">73e2562fcf244b908935fb251d851c78</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="ServiceNow AI Readiness Optimization Platform">73e2562fcf244b908935fb251d851c78</sys_scope><sys_update_name>x_snc_airop_check_definition_8c54c5b5cf2d0fd48935fb251d851c74</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-06-18 18:14:18</sys_updated_on></x_snc_airop_check_definition></record_update>
